usageErrorFragment: is invalid. It must be 'auto', or between 100k and 1M
comment: Claude's auto-compact window is a user-global setting (autoCompactWindow in ~/.claude/settings.json), so a spawn that names no window inherits whatever the machine's owner last set. --autocompact is the per-invocation override Kanna passes on every claude spawn; `auto` restores the model's native window. accepted[] and rejected[] are the values measured against the CLI at measuredCliVersion; `tokens` is the window the CLI then reported through /context.
shorthand: A bare number is read as thousands when it is at most 1000, and as raw tokens above that: 200 and 200000 are both 200k, while 5000 is 5000 tokens and out of range.
